verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents a self-hosted deployment that runs in your own cloud or on-premises environment (AWS or any Kubernetes platform, including Azure, GCP, Oracle and OpenShift), which lets an organization control where its data lives [mintlify-docs-18]. There is no evidence of region or residency selection for the hosted SaaS, so choosing a location means taking on self-hosting. Missing for 10: region/residency selection on the managed SaaS, documentation of which data stays in-environment under self-hosting (e.g., AI assistant processing), and independent corroboration.
